cohort: 1000 parturient women at high risk of bleeding after undergoing a cesarean section
finding: Prophylactic TxA administration during high-risk cesarean section effectively reduced blood loss, resulting in lower ICU admission rates and shorter hospitalization without increasing complication rates or negatively impacting neonatal outcomes.
